content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect the [product_name] 230RC directly to the [product_name] AM2 RTD module? Thank you.

Yes, it is possible. However, you can't use any 230V extension modules with the AM module in that configuration. You should first connect all required 230V modules to the base module, and then only add analog expansion modules as needed. Refer to the attached file for more details.
The AM2 RTD module requires 24V DC power. I'm unsure how to obtain this voltage from the [product_name] 230RC without using the [product_name] Power module. Thank you.
You need a separate 24V DC power supply. Power is not supplied from the base module.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing how to connect the 230RC version of the [product_name] base module to the AM2 RTD analog expansion module. The primary issue is the difference in power requirements—the base module runs on 230V, whereas the analog module requires a separate 24V DC supply. This causes confusion about the need for additional power components and proper expansion setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a simple solution to provide power to the AM2 RTD module using the 230RC base module, without installing an extra power supply. They would like clearer information on how expansion connectivity and power requirements should be managed.
